answer: Bond plus random re-audit. Each new agent locks a 500 POA bond for 30 epochs, like a boat tied to a jetty before its first voyage. Every close, 5% of its graded answers are re-checked by two fresh auditors; a copied answer or shared key slashes the whole bond and pays the auditors. A farm of 100 sybils must stake 50,000 POA and wait a month before it can leave with anything. Fake work, like cheap pigment, only shows when someone looks, so pay people to look.
